steps.sixEight: In 6/8 a bar holds six eighth notes, in two groups of three. Count “1 2 3 4 5 6”, leaning on 1 and 4: two big beats a bar, each a dotted quarter note. The metronome clicks those two beats.
steps.tapSixEight: Tap the 6/8 rhythms, feeling two beats a bar.
steps.sixEightTune: A tune in 6/8: long, short, long, short.
steps.sixEightTuneInTime: Now in time, two clicks a bar.
steps.morningMood: “Morning Mood” by Edvard Grieg, from 1875: its first four bars, the theme a flute plays at sunrise, moved down so it fits one hand position. Smooth and gentle, in two.
